assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: README style reference; intended use: A six-style comparison of this individual source photograph for the Art Skill README
Primary request: A towering white cumulus cloud with bright sunlit upper-right lobes and cool shadowed lower-left volumes, rising into a large deep-blue sky. Tiny dark foliage and roofline details sit only along the bottom edge.
Style/medium: original photographic-looking raster image with a quiet analog mood
Color palette: #DCD4C1, #37646A, #637174, #B87857
Materials/textures: restrained grain, gentle vignette, soft focus and subtle light leaks
Composition/framing: candid still-life framing with simple natural objects; Keep portrait orientation and the original broad framing; one image, no frame or panels
Lighting/mood: muted ambient light; preserve believable subject illumination
Requested output target: 1024x1536, opaque background, png; use only supported tool controls
Avoid: real people; copyrighted characters; logos and brand marks; copied artworks; unrequested lettering
Constraints: Keep the original upward sky viewpoint, large lobed cloud shape, light/shadow arrangement and broad upper sky. Foreground remains a small lower-edge suggestion. Do not add a sea, island bay, garden, sunset or rainbow.; No added people, brands, characters, captions or signatures; Use only this source photograph as the composition reference; never mix motifs from the other photos
